# Drake trophy

Type: Trophy | Internal ID: TrophyHatchling | Source: Drake | Usage: Ballista, , Crafting, Decoration | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

The Drake Trophy is a rare drop from Drakes in the Mountains.

### Crafting

• Drake helmet
• Frosty fishing bait
• Blob bomb: Frost

### Misc

• Can be displayed in an Item Stand.
• Can be used to program the Ballista.
